function.name: start_intake
function.description: Start a new saved intake from what the person first said (or a public link they gave). Call once, at the start. Returns session_id, a 6-digit resume_code, what is already known, and the next question.

starting_input.description: The person's opening description of the problem, in their words (translated to English if needed), or one public http(s) link.

function.name: resume_intake
function.description: Re-open a paused or earlier intake using the 6-digit resume code the person reads out. Returns the same next question they stopped at.

function.name: get_status
function.description: Get the saved progress and the next step for a session. Use if unsure what to ask next.

function.name: save_answer
function.description: Save what the person said for one field (also used to change an earlier answer). Split their answer into short statements and label each one.

field.description: Which brief field this is about.

value.description: Their answer in English, faithful to what they said. For field "category" use one of: map_data, navigation_route, traffic_eta, search_places, business_listing, app_performance, telematics_device, account_billing, other.

statements.description: Their answer split into short statements. observation = they saw or measured it themselves; claim = reported by others or a generalisation like "always"/"everyone"; assumption = a guess about cause or fix.

function.name: suggest_answer
function.description: Propose an answer for a still-open field from facts the person already gave. It is NOT saved as their answer until they confirm it with confirm_suggestion.

field.description: Which brief field this is about.

basis.description: Which earlier statement this comes from.

function.name: confirm_suggestion
function.description: The person said a suggested answer is right. Only call right after they clearly agree.

field.description: Which brief field this is about.

function.name: mark_unknown
function.description: The person does not know or does not want to say. Keeps the gap visible in the brief instead of guessing.

field.description: Which brief field this is about.

function.name: pause_intake
function.description: The person wants to stop for now. Saves progress; read them the resume_code from the result.

function.name: get_preview
function.description: Get the full brief to read back for final review. Returns version — pass it unchanged to finalize_intake.

function.name: finalize_intake
function.description: Only after reading the latest preview aloud and the person explicitly says approve, or explicitly says cancel. Approving saves the brief for the Mappls team; it does not send anything to anyone.

preview_version.description: The version from the get_preview you read aloud.
